changes: Voicitool and the setup now start in your Windows language. The setup language can be changed at the top right.
Updates can be installed from inside the app: a note appears at the top when a new version is out.
After starting, the small start window stays until Voicitool is ready and then brings it to the front.
After an update, the installation is checked in the background instead of opening the whole setup.
A failed update no longer blocks the start. Voicitool then simply starts the version you already have.
